prerequisites: ELEC-C9110 Circuit analysis or ELEC-C4110 Circuit analysis I or equivalent knowledge

learning_outcomes.text: Students can analyze the transient behavior of circuits using the Laplace transform and know concepts that pertain to system functions.
The student knows the most essential characteristics and properties of various amplifier models and understands their effect on the transfer function.
The student is able to model the frequency dependency if the amplifer models, knows the limitations caused by amplifier non-idealities, and can to analyze asimple amplifier circuits.
The student can analyze the most common operational amplifier circuits and the affect of non-idealities in operational amplifier circuits.

syllabus_topics: Operational amplifier circuits and the effect of nonidealities
